subject: Reprioritizing LumenLab POC — next steps and optional kickoff office hours
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumenlab.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@lumenlab.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: LumenLab discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Elaine / Samir —

Great speaking with you today. Quick recap from my side and a suggested plan to get the POC running: 

- Goals you mentioned: improve entity extraction latency in the inference pipeline, and reduce per-request cost for high-volume inference.
- Success metrics: < 150ms 95th-percentile latency on 512-token requests; cost <= $0.0009/token (target) for steady-state.
- Constraints: data residency requirement in us-west, SOC2 evidence for initial integration, and a small infra team (1 engineer) who will own deployment.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (LL-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx) with owner/responsibility and timeline.
2) Kickoff a 90-minute technical session next week (I can run the first 30m with product, then Marissa will join for engineering setup and Ben for performance tuning).
3) We’ll provision a short-lived trial instance in us-west and share the onboarding checklist so your engineer can complete setup in ~2–3 hours.

Can you confirm: (a) whether next Wednesday 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30 PT works for your team, and (b) who will be the main engineering contact?

If you'd like SOC2 summary and our onboarding checklist beforehand I can send both now (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, kickoff-setup-checklist.md).

Thanks — happy to adjust the timeline if you’re prioritizing differently.

— Diego
Diego Fernández | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: LL-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 4 pages), kickoff-setup-checklist.md (text)
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumenlab.ai>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenLab discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30 PT works for Samir and me. Our engineering contact will be Priya (priya@lumenlab.ai) — she’s out of the office until Tuesday but will join the kickoff.

A couple of quick asks before the session:
- Can you send the SOC2 summary and the onboarding checklist now so Priya can skim before the meeting?
- Does Redwood provide a small sample dataset we can use during the POC, or should we bring replacement test data?

Looking forward to it.

— Elaine
Elaine Park | Head of ML Platforms | LumenLab
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-05T07:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenLab discovery recap + proposed next steps

Thanks Elaine — sending the docs now and confirm kickoff calendar invite sent for 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30 PT.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, kickoff-setup-checklist.md

Regarding test data: we can provide a small synthetic corpus (anonymized) that mirrors your typical request sizes; it’s in the Drive folder I linked in the MAP. If you prefer to use your own data, Priya is fine to upload during the session.

Agenda for kickoff (high level):
- 10:00–10:20 — product overview + testcases (me)
- 10:20–11:00 — engineering setup + credentials (Marissa)
- 11:00–11:30 — perf tuning and quantization options (Ben)

If Priya can’t make the full slot, we’ll record the technical portion and follow up with action items.

— Diego

Date: 2026-08-12T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Quick check — trial provisioning not yet used / offer to help unblock

Hi Elaine / Samir —

Following up after the kickoff: we provisioned the trial instance on 2026-08-06 and shared temporary credentials and the quick-start checklist. I’m seeing no API activity from your end yet. Two possible reasons we commonly see:

- engineering bandwidth ran into a higher priority, or
- credentials/config steps hit a permissions or networking issue.

Possible options to move forward quickly:
1) 60-minute office hours with Marissa (engineer) and Ben (perf) — we’ll walk through the checklist, validate connectivity, and run an end-to-end request with our sample corpus. Proposed slots: 2026-08-13 09:00 PT or 2026-08-14 11:00 PT.
2) If you’ve deprioritized the POC, we can pause the trial and revisit planning when you’re ready.

If helpful, here are the direct steps we can take this week to troubleshoot:
- confirm the API key is active and not blocked by a network ACL
- validate VPC egress rules (sample curl I included in the checklist)
- grant Priya temporary elevated role if she needs to complete provisioning (we keep access strictly scoped).

Please let me know which option you prefer by EOD Wed 2026-08-13 — if I don’t hear back I’ll tentatively hold the 2026-08-14 11:00 PT slot and follow up one last time.

Thanks —
Diego

Hi Diego —

Apologies for the radio silence. We had a resource reprioritization — Priya was pulled onto an on-call rotation and our infra team is stretched this quarter. We still like the plan and value the MAP, but we need to pause active work on the POC for now.

Could you:
- keep the trial instance and MAP available;
- touch base in 6 weeks for a re-prioritization check; and
- remove any nonessential calendar holds on your side so our calendars clear up.

If anything changes on our side sooner I’ll reach out — thanks for the clear offers to help.

— Elaine
Elaine Park | Head of ML Platforms | LumenLab
